capabilities: Manage tasks with natural-language entry, Kanban, recurring tasks and a live timer
Track time and compute earnings from hourly or daily rates
Plan budgets, savings goals, income and expenses with Markdown or Excel summaries
Run local Ollama AI for task extraction, summaries, schedule commands and chat
Send desktop and phone reminders via ntfy.sh
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not only a calendar: it also bundles tasks, time tracking, habits, finances, notifications and local AI.
extras: Stores data as JSON in calendar-data/; warns financial data syncs unencrypted via cloud; AI is desktop-only; bundles a theme; Russian README available.
intentEvidence: This project is based on obsidian-calendar-plugin by Liam Cain (MIT) and has been significantly expanded.
motivation: Built to connect planning, execution and analysis in one system so tasks, calendar, tracked time and finances do not have to be entered multiple times across different apps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, task, time, habit or finance tracking, so users juggle separate apps and re-enter the same data in spreadsheets.
